lines.text: David said he would guard his mouth with a muzzle while the wicked were present, and he stayed silent.
David's heart grew hot within him, and he asked the LORD to show him his end.
David said the LORD made his days as cubits, and that men heap up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
David said his hope was in the Lord, and he asked to be delivered from all his transgressions.
David called himself a foreigner dwelling with the LORD, a stranger like all his sons, and asked Him to turn His gaze away.
